title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
We are a fast-growing SaaS company building software for service businesses across North America. We are looking for a Senior Flutter Developer with strong backend skills to join our core team full-time. You will work directly with the founders and the development team, own features from design to release, and help shape the product for the long term. 
 Role & responsibilities: - Design, build and maintain cross-platform apps (iOS, Android and Web) using Flutter and Dart - Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Firebase and SQL databases - Build new product features across scheduling and dispatch, CRM, estimates and invoicing, payments, maps and GPS, customer messaging, reporting and AI-powered features - Improve performance, fix bugs and debug issues in a large production codebase - Review architecture, suggest improvements and write clean, maintainable, well-tested code - Work closely with product and engineering teammates to ship quickly and reliably 
 Preferred candidate profile: - 4+ years of professional Flutter and Dart experience, with production apps published on the App Store and Play Store - Strong backend experience: Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions), SQL databases, authentication and authorization - Good command of state management, REST APIs and Git - Experience debugging and maintaining large production applications - Strong ownership, problem-solving and communication skills - Excellent written and spoken English, as you will work with a North American customer base - Good to have: SaaS product experience, AWS, Stripe or other payment gateways, Google Maps, push notifications and AI integrations 
 Perks and benefits: - Long-term, full-time role with direct access to the founders and real product ownership - Fully remote work - Competitive salary of 16 to 18 LPA

Key Skills: Rest API Integration,SQL,GIT,AWS,Firestore,Dart,Senior,Integration

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining backend applications and APIs while working closely with product, frontend, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
